title: Local LLM Hook Migration — Ollama-Powered Advisory Hooks
description: Migrate advisory hooks from Claude API consumption to local Ollama inference. Reduces hook overhead from ~1200 tokens/edit to ~0 by using local regex validation and Ollama for intelligent suggestions. Leverages existing OllamaTaskOffloaderEngine and LocalValidationEngine infrastructure.
goals: Eliminate API token consumption from advisory hooks (targeting 80-95% reduction)
Replace 6 validation hooks with unified local regex validation
Create Ollama bridge for context-injection hooks requiring intelligence
Maintain hook functionality while removing Claude API dependency

units.title: Unified Local Validation Hook — Replace 6 Validation Hooks
units.description: Created unified-local-validation.mjs hook that replaces 6 disabled advisory hooks (naming-convention-enforcer, complexity-gate, type-safety-checker, magic-number-detector, async-pattern-checker, performance-pattern-detector) with local regex validation. Zero API tokens consumed.
deliverables: Wired to settings.json PreToolUse Edit|Write|MultiEdit matcher
acceptance_criteria: Performs naming, complexity, type, magic number, async, and performance checks

units.title: OllamaHookBridgeEngine — Hook-to-Ollama Communication Layer
units.description: Create bridge engine enabling hooks to call Ollama for intelligent suggestions. Handles connection pooling, timeout management, and fallback to no-op when Ollama unavailable. Used by context-injection hooks that need LLM intelligence.
deliverables: Wire 3 actions to prism_dev: ollama_hook_query, ollama_hook_status, ollama_hook_config
acceptance_criteria: Synchronous query with 500ms timeout for hook use
Configurable model selection per hook type

units.title: Context Hook Migration — Ollama-Powered Suggestions
units.description: Migrate 2 registered context-injection hooks (grep-index-first, mcp-route-suggest) to use OllamaHookBridge instead of consuming Claude API tokens. Hooks provide intelligent suggestions using local inference.
deliverables: Remove DISABLED_TOKEN_REDUX marker from migrated hooks
acceptance_criteria: grep-index-first provides index suggestions via Ollama
mcp-route-suggest provides route suggestions via Ollama
Both hooks function when Ollama unavailable (silent no-op)

units.title: Hook Cleanup — Remove Disabled Markers and Dead Code
units.description: Remove DISABLED_TOKEN_REDUX markers from all migrated hooks. Clean up hooks that are fully replaced (not registered, functionality covered by unified hook). Update hook registry documentation.
deliverables: Delete or archive fully-replaced hook files
Update PRISM-INVENTORY-LATEST.md with new hook counts
acceptance_criteria: Hook count in inventory reflects actual active hooks
README documents which hooks use local vs API inference

existing_engines_to_leverage: OllamaTaskOffloaderEngine — task classification and model selection
